## Created by:

## Data description:

### Dengue-related data

Dengue-related data were obtained from the Weekly Epidemiological Reports published by the Ministry of Health, Sri Lanka. These data are available in a tidy format through the [denguedatahub](https://thiyangt.github.io/denguedatahubweb/) ~~https://denguedatahub.netlify.app~~ package. In addition, Ministry of Health (MOH) area related data were sourced from the National Dengue Control Unit.

### Population data

Population data were obtained from the Department of Census and Statistics, based on the 2024 Census.
